_: Hard words used and never introduced, per theme; days whose primer covers none of
the words the day leaves unexplained; and terms a junior edition explains only once.
Same two properties as concept-debt.json: a row NOT on this list fails immediately,
so nothing new drifts in; and a row on this list that has since been fixed also
fails, naming the line to delete, so the file cannot become a standing excuse. It
only shrinks. Regenerate one theme's rows with `checkJargon.mjs <theme> --record`.
This file exists because askedText was widened to read `guide`, `background` and a
reading's value and note. Those fields carry much of the prose on a modern card and
had never been inspected, so 16 themes went red at once. Red Sand is absent because
its four were paid off rather than recorded.
Some rows are noise the hard-word test itself produces rather than real defects --
rule and from TERMS entries that are ordinary English in these games. Those want
fixing in the lexicon, not glossing on a card. They are recorded rather than hidden
so that the triage stays visible.
